text: 1.Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens.2.Applicants must be physically and mentally healthy, and possess good conduct and academic performance.3.Academic and age requirements:For undergraduate applicants: Must hold a high school diploma and be under 25 years of age.For master’s degree applicants: Must hold a bachelor’s degree and be under 35 years of age.Applicants under the age of 18 must submit a notarized letter of guardianship in China.4.Language proficiency requirements:Program Language RequirementsUndergraduate: Transportation Engineering (Chinese-taught) Generally, HSK Level 3 or above. Those who have not achieved 180 points or above in HSK Level 4 must undertake one year of preparatory study after enrollment.Master’s: Road and Railway Engineering (English-taught) TOEFL score of 68 or above, IELTS score of 5.5 or above, or Duolingo score of 85 or above.Applicants from English-speaking countries or those whose previous degree programs were taught in English are exempt from providing English proficiency certificates.
